Germination of three crops

Source: R/data.R
germination.Rd

Germination of mungbean, rice and wheat seeds at temperatures between 10 and 40 degrees Celsius, recorded daily for up to 18 days: time-to-event data with several curves.

Usage

germination

Format

A data frame with 192 rows and 5 variables:

temp

temperature (degrees Celsius)

species

a factor with levels mungbean, rice and wheat

start

left endpoint of the monitoring interval (days)

end

right endpoint of the monitoring interval (days)

germinated

number of seeds germinated in the interval

Source

From the package drcData.

Details

For each species and temperature, 20 seeds were placed in a Petri dish in a dark climate cabinet (10, 16, 22, 28, 34 or 40 degrees Celsius; not all temperatures for all species), and the germinated seeds were counted and removed daily.

References

Ritz, C., Pipper, C. B. and Streibig, J. C. (2013) Analysis of germination data from agricultural experiments. European Journal of Agronomy, 45, 1–6.

Examples

wheat <- subset(germination, species == "wheat" & temp == 22)
wmod <- drmTMB(germinated ~ start + end, data = wheat, model = "loglogistic", family = "event",
               start = c(b5 = 0), fix = c(b5 = TRUE))
ed(wmod, 50)
#> Effective dose estimates:
#> 
#>        Estimate Std.Error
#> 50:lf1     3.83     0.216
